groups.problem: The deleteMany OR branch `{retryCount: {gt: 1}}` has no `method: SMS` filter, so it deletes any WorkflowReminder with retryCount > 1, not just SMS reminders.
groups.rationale: All of these point at the same unscoped OR clause in deleteMany and propose scoping it to SMS. S3 frames it as a mismatch with the comment, but the underlying problem and fix are the same.

groups.problem: retryCount is not incremented when message is empty or sendTo is falsy, so those reminders are fetched again on every cron run and never reach the retry cleanup.
groups.rationale: Both point out that the outer `if (message?.length && sendTo)` has no else path that increments retryCount.

problems: `reminder.retryCount + 1` uses a stale value, so concurrent runs can lose increments; an atomic increment should be used.
The retryCount update inside the catch block can throw and break the loop.
